fields.description:
## Context
/dso:implementation-plan can produce plans — and /dso:sprint can execute them — resting on unverified assumptions about external-integration behavior (third-party API response shapes, external library runtime behavior, external-service data contracts, auth flows). When an assumption is wrong it surfaces mid-implementation, wasting rework cycles for the orchestrator agents running these skills and the developers whose cycles are burned. This epic adds a blocking experimental-verification gate at the plan->implementation boundary.

## Success Criteria
1. /dso:implementation-plan extracts external-integration assumptions into a machine-readable Integration Assumptions Ledger section (unique parser-safe header); a plan with none carries an explicit "no external assumptions" attestation with a RATIONALE (an empty ledger cannot trivially pass). The Ledger / SPIKE_VERDICT / injected task-spec field schema is documented in a canonical contract doc (plugins/dso/docs/contracts/integration-assumptions-ledger.md) referenced by implementation-plan SKILL.md — the coordination point for other planning-injector epics.
   Verify-intent: Run implementation-plan against a fixture story containing an external API assumption; confirm a Ledger section with that assumption is emitted, and against a no-external-boundary story confirm the "no external assumptions" attestation + RATIONALE is written.
2. Each ledger assumption has a dedicated spike (verification) task carrying a machine-readable SPIKE_VERDICT (verified-passed | refuted) written by a new verdict-writer CLI distinct from bare closure; every dependent implementation task declares a resolvable depends_on on that spike. A verified-passed verdict must cite an --artifact (log/hash/transcript); the gate rejects a verified-passed verdict lacking one.
   Verify-intent: Create a spike task, write SPIKE_VERDICT verified-passed with an artifact via the CLI, and confirm the implementation task's depends_on resolves and the gate accepts; confirm a verified-passed without artifact is rejected.
3. check-assumptions-verified.sh, invoked from sprint task-readiness (ticket-next-batch.sh), defers dispatch of any implementation task whose upstream spike lacks a verified-passed verdict, emitting a SKIPPED_ASSUMPTIONS_UNVERIFIED reason the sprint SKIPPED_* parse table recognizes; load-bearing once in enforce mode (DSO_ASSUMPTIONS_VERIFIED_MODE=enforce + required-checks.txt).
   Verify-intent: In enforce mode, query ticket ready --epic with an implementation task whose spike is unverified; confirm the task is deferred with the SKIPPED reason and not dispatched.
4. A refuted assumption emits exactly one REPLAN_TRIGGER:validation event (written on the parent story where the re-invocation guard reads it) and zero dependent implementation-task dispatches for that assumption — verifiable in the ticket event log during an in-session end-to-end run with a seeded refuted assumption — rather than a mid-implementation patch.
   Verify-intent: Seed a spike that refutes its assumption; confirm one REPLAN_TRIGGER:validation on the parent story and zero dependent dispatches in the event log.
5. A planned task touching plugins/dso/scripts/runners/ carries a mandatory, un-mergeable paired runner-equivalence sub-task (asserts bash-runner.sh and suite-engine.sh produce identical classification) whose depends_on references the runner-equivalence baseline corpus (ticket ed62-08cd); when the corpus is absent the planner emits the sub-task with a PRECONDITIONS degradation note rather than failing; injection is idempotent across replans.
   Verify-intent: Run implementation-plan on a task editing a runners/ script; confirm exactly one paired runner-equivalence sub-task is created with the corpus depends_on, and re-running (replan) does not duplicate it.
6. A planned task touching shell hooks/runners/platform-sensitive scripts carries reviewer flags correctness:hermeticity and correctness:platform; a visible HALT (not a silent no-op) is emitted when the target ticket type lacks a reviewer-flags field.
   Verify-intent: Run implementation-plan on a task editing a hook script; confirm both flags appear in the task spec, and on a ticket type without the field confirm a HALT with remediation rather than silent skip.

## Milestone Structure
Single epic, owner-confirmed bundling:
- Milestone A (core gate): SC1-SC4 — self-contained, no external-epic blockers.
- Milestone B (injection features): SC5-SC6 — SC5 hard-blocked on ed62-08cd; SC6 coordinate with 7575-5a90 / a47f-b451. Bundled because both are the same plan-time injection-layer code surface. De-escalation trigger: if Milestone B's upstream epics are unmerged ~2 sprints after Milestone A completes, SC5/SC6 extract to a follow-on epic so the accepted coupling cost stays time-bounded.

## Dependencies
- ed62-08cd (Cross-runner equivalence contract testing) — REQUIRED-FIRST for SC5's runner-equivalence baseline corpus.
- 7575-5a90 / a47f-b451 (reviewer rubric items for correctness:hermeticity / correctness:platform) — COORDINATE for SC6; flag names agreed before SC6 ships.

## Approach
Approach A (plan-emits-blocking-verification-tasks): during planning, implementation-plan extracts external-integration assumptions into an Integration Assumptions Ledger and emits one blocking spike task per assumption that dependent implementation tasks depend_on; check-assumptions-verified.sh (consulted by sprint ticket-next-batch.sh) blocks dispatch until the spike carries a verified-passed SPIKE_VERDICT; a refuted assumption routes a replan via the existing REPLAN_TRIGGER:validation machinery before any dependent implementation task runs. Planning stays deterministic; verification executes in sprint where the runtime/env lives.

## Scenario Analysis
- Gate satisfied by bare closed rather than an explicit verified-passed verdict (critical) — mitigated by SC2's verdict primitive + artifact requirement.
- Gate silently advisory if not promoted to enforce mode (high) — SC3 enforce-mode clause.
- Ledger header collision -> empty ledger trivially passes (high) — SC1 parser-safe header + attestation.
- Closure-state race: implementation task dispatched before gate sees verified state (high) — implementation caution (depends_on closed-status backstop + gate check).
- Empty / zero-extraction trivial pass (high) — SC1 attestation + RATIONALE.
- Malformed depends_on spike ID unresolvable (high) — SC2 resolvable requirement.
- Replan re-runs injection -> duplicate runner-equivalence sub-tasks (medium) — SC5 idempotency.
- G4-M3 flag injection no-op on ticket types lacking the field (medium) — SC6 HALT.
- Replan may retain the refuted assumption in revised tasks (high) — implementation caution for the replan instruction.
- Spike closure vs review gate when there is no code artifact (high) — implementation caution (verdict via comment, not a commit).
- Runner-equivalence corpus must exist before G2-M2 injection (high) — SC5 precondition + graceful degradation.

## Cross-Epic Interactions
- 9ddd-117b (Incorporate Architect Agent Pattern into implementation plan) — CONFLICT/COORDINATE: both insert logic into the same implementation-plan planning phases. Assign phase ownership and the shared task-spec schema (the SC1 contract doc) before either ships; this epic layers its injection after architect-mapping if 9ddd-117b lands first.
- af26-dd5a (load-bearing HARD-gates via tool-use-time enforcement) — COORDINATE: check-assumptions-verified.sh composes with af26-dd5a gate infrastructure; gate ordering documented in implementation-plan SKILL.md.
- Other planning-injector epics (4001-7ad3, 853a-c719, 857d-a35a, 94ed-f55c, c206-5acb, d63f-2c74, dso-uvyl, f7d5-59e4) — CONSIDERATION: the SC1 canonical schema contract doc is the coordination point preventing task-spec field collisions.

## Prompt Alignment Findings (for the implementation-plan author)
- Inclusion-first extraction: enumerate positive cases that MUST be extracted, plus a two-condition exemption gate (owned AND versioned within repo AND covered by an existing integration test) plus an "if in doubt, extract" tie-breaker — counters under-classifying external assumptions as internal.
- Ground the verdict: verified-passed requires an --artifact citation; the gate rejects a verified-passed verdict lacking one (analogous to the review-defense --reviewer-hash requirement).
- Make constraints reachable from enforcement: add an assumption_ledger_completeness dimension to the Step-4 plan reviewer completeness.md and a runner_equivalence dimension to safety.md; use HALT (not "warning") vocabulary for the missing reviewer-flags-field case.
- REPLAN placement: the refuted-spike REPLAN_TRIGGER:validation must be written on the parent story (where check-reinvocation.sh greps), not on the spike task.

## State Lifecycle
| Variable | CREATE | UPDATE | CONSUME | RETIRE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Integration Assumptions Ledger (plan description section) | /dso:implementation-plan on plan generation | immutable once written | check-assumptions-verified.sh, dso:completion-verifier | lives/dies with the story ticket |
| SPIKE_VERDICT (canonical comment on spike task) | verdict-writer CLI (spike executor in sprint) | n/a | check-assumptions-verified.sh | lives/dies with the spike ticket |
| REPLAN_TRIGGER:validation (comment on parent story) | spike executor on refute | resolved by REPLAN_RESOLVED:implementation-plan | check-reinvocation.sh (implementation-plan re-invocation guard) | superseded on REPLAN_RESOLVED |
| reviewer flags correctness:hermeticity / correctness:platform (task spec) | /dso:implementation-plan on runner/hook/platform touch | n/a | dso:code-reviewer-* at review time | lives/dies with the task ticket |
